treaty_name: Convention between the United Arab Republic and the Republic of Iraq for the avoidance of double taxation and prevention of tax evasion with regard to income and capital taxes (1968)
source_title: Egyptian Tax Authority: English guiding translation of the UAR-Iraq Convention (from Official Gazette no. 50 of 16/12/1971; Arabic authentic)

rates.quote: Interest paid by a resident of Iraq to a resident of the United Arab Republic shall not be subject to tax in Iraq at a rate exceeding 10 % plus the national defence tax.

notes: DIVIDENDS omitted: Art. 9 allows the source State to tax dividends 'in accordance with the laws of that State' with no treaty cap. Interest: Iraq-source interest capped at 10% PLUS the Iraqi national defence tax (the 10% cap is therefore not an all-in limit; modelled as 10 with source_state IQ); Egypt-source interest (Art. 10(2)) remains subject to Egyptian movable-capital tax, defence tax, national security tax and supplementary taxes without a stated cap (only general income tax waived for individuals) - not modelled. ROYALTIES omitted: Art. 11(1) allows source taxation 'at a rate equal to half that of the applicable tax rate' (relative, not a fixed percentage). Art. 27(2): Iraq - from the first financial year beginning after EIF (EIF 1968-12-02; valid_from 1969-01-01 assumes a calendar financial year - not verified); Egypt - movable-capital tax due on or after EIF. Text read is ETA's English guiding translation; the Arabic text is authentic (Arabic only). Iraq is not an MLI signatory - no PPT; no treaty-level PPT.
